verdict.rationale: The MCP server separates reads from writes and deletes, so each category can be approved independently. That gives an agent some least-privilege control, but at the tool-approval level rather than through scoped credentials. Per-integration API keys exist only for sending data in, and the CLI is described as giving agents full workspace access. missing for 10: documented issuance of agent-specific scoped API keys or tokens, per-resource or per-action permission scoping on credentials, read-only key options, revocation and rotation guidance, independent corroboration.
